div.h1: A dedicated team behind every event
div.p: Since 2019, we’ve helped bring weddings, corporate events and celebrations across Barbados to life, with refined rentals delivered and set up by our team.
Rent It.BB began in 2019 as a family business, and that care for people entrusted to us still shapes everything we do.

Today, we are a full team with a wide collection of rentals, from tents and furniture to linens, tableware and décor. Every piece is held to a high standard of quality, and every order is delivered, set up and collected by our team, so your event is ready before your guests arrive.

Experience has taught us that the details make an event. We are dedicated to delivering excellent service from your first quote to the final pick-up, and we work alongside event planners and coordinators to bring each vision to life.
Whether it’s a wedding, a corporate event or an intimate celebration, our goal is simple: an event that meets your expectations and is remembered for all the right reasons.

img.alt: An event set up by the Rent It.BB team

figure.blockquote: “As we were looking to do a few events, I told my work mates about this page that I stumbled across that had some rental items called ‘Rent It BB’… Then that was where I met this wonderful team!”
“The service and communication were way above anything that we had expected.”

“It was a bank holiday and everyone knows how hard it is to move from your bed on a day off, but that was no problem. [The team] said that [they] would still come and set the tents up for our staff party.”
